data.name: Diyaa
data.gender_notes: Diyaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Diyaa is an Arabic name that symbolizes illumination and enlightenment. It represents a person who spreads knowledge and wisdom. The name Diyaa carries the meaning “Shining Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Diyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Diyaa is associated with the light of faith and guidance.
data.etymology: Diyaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diyaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ضياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل ضاء يضيء ضوءا، وهو مصدر على وزن فعيل، ويعني النور والاشراق والنجاح والظهور. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2: «الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ الْقُرْآنَ ضِيَاءً وَشِفَاءً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ»

in_urdu.name: ضیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کے الفاظ ضاء سے ماخوذ، جس کے معنی ہیں نور، روشنی، اشراق، کامیابی، اور ظہور. اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کو اچھے معنی کے ساتھ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں فرقان سورة کی دوسری آیت میں کیا گیا ہے: «الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ الْقُرْآنَ ضِيَاءً وَشِفَاءً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ»

in_hindi.name: दिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'ضاء' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश, उज्ज्वलता, सफलता और प्रकट होना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, इस नाम का उपयोग अच्छे अर्थों में किया जाता है, खासकर जब इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में सूरा अल-फुरकान की दूसरी आयत में किया गया है: «الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ الْقُرْآنَ ضِيَاءً وَشِفَاءً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ»

in_pashto.name: ضياء
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنی یې د رڼا، براق، بریالتی، او څرګندېدل دي. په اسلامي دود کې، دغه نوم په ښو مانا استعمال شوی، په ځانګړې توګه کله چې د قران کریم په فرقان سورت کې يې ذکر شوی: «الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ الْقُرْآنَ ضِيَاءً وَشِفَاءً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ»

in_english.name: Diyaa
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ḍ-w-ʾ', which means light, brightness, success, and appearance. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significance as it is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Furqan, verse 2: 'He who sent down the Quran to you is the Most Merciful, so follow it and listen [to its teachings].'

data.cultural_impact: The name Diyaa holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is derived from the Arabic root "D-Y-A", which stands for "light" or "illumination". Historically, the name was given to individuals who were scholars, wise men, and educators. It is also associated with the concept of "Diya al-Ilm" or the "Light of Knowledge". In modern times, it is not uncommon for a child to be named Diyaa in honor of a respected scholar or teacher.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Diyaa embodies the Islamic values of knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment. It is believed that the person named Diyaa will be a beacon of knowledge and wisdom, guiding others towards the path of truth and righteousness. According to Islamic teachings,knowledge is a means to draw closer to God and to live a virtuous life. Thus, the name Diyaa holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom in order to deepen one's connection with God.
